ALTER TABLE task
    ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS allowed_errors_count smallint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS task_test (
    id uuid PRIMARY KEY,
    task_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES task(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    "order" smallint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS task_test_i18n (
    task_test_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES task_test(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    i18n_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES i18n(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    title varchar(255) NOT NULL,
    description text NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    PRIMARY KEY (task_test_id, i18n_id)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS task_test_variant (
    id uuid PRIMARY KEY,
    task_test_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES task_test(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    "order" smallint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    is_correct boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS task_test_variant_i18n (
    task_test_variant_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES task_test_variant(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    i18n_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES i18n(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    text varchar(1024) NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (task_test_variant_id, i18n_id)
);

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS task_test_task_order_unique_idx
    ON task_test(task_id, "order");

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS task_test_variant_test_order_unique_idx
    ON task_test_variant(task_test_id, "order");

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS task_test_variant_single_correct_idx
    ON task_test_variant(task_test_id)
    WHERE is_correct = true;
